🔄 Content updated (Published: August 28, 2026 / Previous: July 23, 2026)
Main changes: On August 28, responses to proposal questions, utility cost survey forms, and repair history lists were newly published.

Hanno City is accepting proposals for a comprehensive facility management system. The program covers 81 facilities including City Hall and seeks two types of proposals:

• A Proposal: Comprehensive management of maintenance inspections and facility upkeep
• B Proposal: Added-value services such as revenue-generating projects, energy management, power procurement, and digital transformation (DX)

【Schedule】
July 2026: Call for proposals opens
July–August 2026: Expressions of interest and questions accepted; matchmaking support provided
August–September 2026: Proposal submission period
Late September 2026: Review process
Early October 2026: Review results announced
October 2026–March 2027: Detailed negotiations
April 1, 2027: Operations begin

The city will also provide matchmaking support between eligible operators. For full details, see the implementation guidelines and published materials.

【Contact】Hanno City General Policy Department, Asset Management Division
Phone: 042-973-2111 (ext. 282)

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/shisankeieika/kanzai/13805.html
